purpose: Determine whether explicitly named retained real EP3/EP4 evidence can populate the frozen PSI0F contract unchanged.

allowed: query-only schema inspection of explicitly named retained EP3/EP4 shadow stores
inspection of retained EP3/EP4 validation reports and frozen contracts
publication of an eligibility verdict and a separately authorized minimum next proposal
forbidden_and_not_performed: service, configuration, deployment, monitoring, activation, operator identity, or EB2 changes

excluded_sources.reason: Production database reads were outside PSI0G-A authority; the path was not opened.

ep3_watchtower.finding: Aggregate shadow parity exists, but no retained operation runtime evaluation payload is identified; 40 of 176 frozen launches lack materialized LAUNCH_SIGNER evidence.

ep3_three_sw2.finding: All 13 historical launches are covered, but health.evaluations is zero and no retained operation runtime evaluation payload is identified.

ep4_discovery.finding: Deterministic candidate counts and digests are retained (14203 and 94 for the two known corpora), but candidate payload persistence occurred only in temporary validation storage; operation_contracts_loaded is zero.

missing_evidence_blockers.detail: Neither eligible retained store contains the operation contract, snapshot, detector-result, topology-revision, or behaviour-observation identities required by F9/F5. Aggregate parity reports cannot substitute for immutable runtime payloads.
EP4 retained counts and candidate digests, but not the complete candidate records, population membership, evidence references, or ordered operation cohort required for unchanged replay.

No immutable manifest can bind a complete F13 retained-input set. Manufacturing operation identifiers, topology, behaviour, role, mechanism, temporal, candidate, or population fields would violate the frozen contract.

authority_separation.semantic_guard: Behavioural similarity may support operational continuity evidence but must not be represented as definite common human identity.

capture_necessity.reason: The two retained generic-evidence corpora may be sufficient to derive the missing EP3/EP4 payloads. That must be tested before requesting provider acquisition.

smallest_separately_authorized_next_prog.name: bounded retained-evidence EP3/EP4 derivation
inputs: the exact two eligible shadow stores and identities recorded above
allowed_if_separately_authorized: read the two bound shadow stores only through immutable/query-only access
derive complete EP3 snapshots, behaviour observations, topology revisions, and detector results without inventing missing facts
derive and retain complete EP4 candidate payloads and their frozen population in a new isolated non-production store
emit a deterministic manifest or exact evidence gaps
still_forbidden: F13 export, PSI0F publication, production integration, monitoring, deployment, or activation

terminal_states.PASS: Complete immutable EP3/EP4 payloads for the two bound real corpora are retained and replay deterministically without weakening PSI0F contracts.
terminal_states.HOLD: Exact underivable facts are identified per contract and operation; only then propose the smallest provider-backed capture cohort needed to obtain those facts.

terminal_statement: HOLD / evidence insufficient. Existing generic evidence is real and substantial, but the complete immutable EP3/EP4 payloads required by PSI0F are not retained. First authorize bounded local derivation over the two named stores; do not yet authorize fresh capture, disposition, publication, monitoring, or activation.
